summary_notes: Q1 2026 reported ~Apr 29-30: net income $134.2M, basic EPS $1.31, revenue $830.7M (beat $741.17M est by ~12%); adjusted EPS $1.29 missed $1.54 forecast. Aerospace Products revenue +104% YoY to $743.8M, EBITDA more than doubled. Dividend raised to $0.45/share (33% growth). New JV with Jereh Group on Mod-1 CFM56 aeroderivative production. Valuation concern: high ~49x P/E, 2026 consensus EPS ~$6.88. Next earnings (Q2 2026) not explicitly dated in results; based on quarterly cadence (last report late Apr/early May) estimate ~late July / early Aug 2026.
